sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (15:00). Despite their commanding league position, Sandbach arrive off the back of a recent loss and will be looking to bounce back against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points. They then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (15:00), another fixture against a side near the foot of the table.
divisionWide: Stafford Town (2nd, 20 points) make the trip to Dawley Town on 3 October in an early title-race test, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall at home the same day. Wolverhampton Casuals, fifth in the standings, travel to Wednesfield Community in what should be a competitive encounter. Fourth-ranked Bilston Town visit Foley Meir, and Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter in particularly poor recent form with five consecutive losses. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, Market Drayton Town host New Mills, and bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social. Midweek action features Brereton Social hosting Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October (19:45). The following Saturday (10 October), Stafford Town face Wednesfield Community at home, while Bilston Town host Crewe and Telford Town visit New Mills—fixtures that could shuffle the mid-table picture.
